source.author: Wowhead Looter aggregate

notes: Previously unlogged item ID 249963, LIVE indexed mutable source snapshot, outcome row 1/2, two separate same-name Dawn Crystal entries. Source reports 40 cumulative base-item disenchants and 27 material-row occurrences with displayed rounded 68%; this is NOT an independently audited zero-inclusive original completed-cast study. At-cast itemLink/bonus, gear ilvl, profession skill/specialization/build, unique player provenance, actual output item ID and rank, per-hit units, histograms, zero-event counts and event dates are unknown. Page's selected bonus/ilvl289 is a selectable tooltip, NOT an observed disenchant-time ilvl. Do not combine same-name rows, assume independent LIVE/PTR populations or use as estimator/production probability.
